thread:
Alex G: Quick sync — sketching a 'staged-degrade orchestrator' for rollouts. Goal: deterministic, per-tenant cascading fallbacks + short automatic rollback windows. Wanted to share the tiny config prototype and get reactions.

Alex G: proto config: ```yaml
route: /generate
variants:
  - id: v2
    weight: 0.1
    backup: v1
    failure_policy: cascade
    obs_window_s: 30
    abort_if_error_rate_pct: 5
  - id: v1
    weight: 0.9
```

Maria L: I like the per-tenant weight but how do we signal "abort_if_error_rate_pct"? do we use p50/p95 latencies + error count or a composite score?

Sam K: composite. error_rate + tail_latency spike. we should also include request-quality signals (e.g. hallucination evals) when available, but fallback must not depend on heavy evals in hot path.

Jess R: +1 to composite. also we need to cap circuit-open propagation — tenants with tiny traffic shouldnt blow the global rollout. maybe require min-reqs threshold before any auto-abort.

Alex G: exactly — plan: require min_requests=200 in obs_window before auto-abort. fallback happens in phases: 1) local hedge (send duplicate to backup with async dedupe), 2) weight shift (10% -> backup), 3) hard swap if sustained > abort threshold for 3 consecutive windows.

Maria L: thoughts on telemetry? we need per-variant counters exposed + a sparse trace sample showing decision reasons. otherwise SRE will be blind when a tenant reports regressions.

Sam K: expose metrics: variant_request_total, variant_success_total, variant_error_total, variant_tail_latency_histogram. and a decision_reason tag with values {latency,error,quality,quota}. traces: sample 1/1000 by default, and 1/10 for rollback windows.

Jess R: how does this interact with caching/KV prefix? if we mirror to backup we might double cache pressure. maybe only mirror cold prefixes or short-circuit heuristics for identical prefixes.

Alex G: plan is prefix-aware mirroring: if prefetched KV exists, do local route; if not, send mirror to backup but mark as speculative (no write). also add a cache-affinity hint to the control-plane so we can warm backups during slow rollouts.

Sam K: rollback guard: add a soft-budget so we don't oscillate. e.g. cannot auto-swap back to variant for at least 30m after hard swap unless manually cleared.

Maria L: ops visibility: surface a compact per-tenant timeline with recent decision_reasons + the last config used. Ops can override via Console -> Rollouts -> Force-hold / Force-swap.

Alex G: ok — action items: (1) i'll open RFC PR with the config proto + metric names, (2) Sam will draft the detection composite formula, (3) Maria/Jess will list SRE/Cache affinity UX for console. any objections?

Jess R: no objections. add a test harness simulating cold cache + heavy tail to validate nondestructive mirroring.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: PR #4123 opened: "staged-degrade-orchestrator: RFC + proto config" (link: https://git.internal/r/4123)

Alex G: thanks — will tag folks on the PR. small follow-up: consider a probabilistic hedging mode (randomized hedging for early windows) vs deterministic mirror; want to discuss on RFC.

Sam K: sounds good. i'll sketch the hedging vs mirror tradeoffs in the draft.

Maria L: ok i'll add a telemetry sketch in the RFC doc.

Jess R: i'll add cache-warmup scenarios and a minimal integration test plan.

Alex G: cool. ping me if you want a short sync after PR review. :thumbsup:
